latestVersion.changelog:
AI Persona OS 1.6.2 — Initial Release

- Launches the complete operating system for OpenClaw agents, featuring zero-terminal agent-driven setup and guided onboarding.
- Includes 24 ready-to-use "souls" (11 original personalities + 13 iconic characters like Thanos, Deadpool, JARVIS, Mary Poppins, Darth Vader, and more).
- Debuts SOUL.md Maker: interview-driven custom persona creation with browsable galleries and quick/deep build options.
- Core features: in-chat commands, context monitoring/protection, enforced heartbeat protocol, traffic-light status, migration, auto-pruning, config validation, version tracking, escalation protocol, security inoculation, team integration, and workspace persistence (all within ~/workspace).
- Strict agent conduct and operational rules for safety, clarity, and reliability.
- No external APIs or network calls required for basic setup; optional openclaw CLI for advanced features.
